attempts.command: T048: write 5003, 5004, 5010 from CoordinationUnits.Report through a CoordinationReport passed by the PostgreSQL ports
attempts.expectedObservation: Every PostgreSQL coordinator failure writes its event
attempts.result: Convergence pass 2: the atomic, lease, cache, and fencing paths write them; CoordinationMaintenance and PostgreSqlCoordinationHealth pass no report, so the finding survives

attempts.command: T053: after a cancelled in-flight acquire, send the holder-checked release for the holder acquire sent
attempts.expectedObservation: No lease is held after a cancelled acquire
attempts.result: Convergence pass 2: an in-flight EVALSHA is undone, but a NOSCRIPT fallback EVAL sent by the abandoned task after the release still grants, so the finding survives

attempts.command: T057: send the NOSCRIPT fallback EVAL through the send gate, so an abandoned acquire sends nothing after the undo
attempts.expectedObservation: No lease is held after a cancelled acquire, even with the script flushed
attempts.result: Convergence pass 3: the gate marks the command sent before ExecuteAsync enqueues it, so an Abandon() in that window lets the undo be enqueued first and the acquire then grants; the finding survives

attempts.command: T055: bound the Redis connection build by the linked token and bound the reset semaphore wait by operationTimeout
attempts.expectedObservation: Every Redis call fails within operationTimeout plus the fixed allowance
attempts.result: Convergence pass 3: the build is bounded, but the authentication-failure reset waits up to a fresh operationTimeout after the call bound may be spent, so the finding survives in part
